name: Bistro Cupid 2
original_name: ビストロ・きゅーぴっと2
source:
It may look old-fashioned by our standards, but this is a different era where electricity and TV do exist.
This is also a world where cooking means way more than it does in our reality.
The story takes place in the great culinary nation known as the Kingdom of Cinnamon.
The Royal Saint Simon Cooking Academy in the capital has produced some of the world's top chefs, people who earned the title "Great Chef." It's a prestigious school with a reputation for being pretty hardcore.
Their motto: "Once you've nailed the basics, it's all about practice." Second-year students, the seniors, do business internships at restaurants outside school. And when that internship starts, so does their graduation exam.

"I might be jumping ahead here, but I've been working part-time since my first year, I know people now and have my eye on some places... so I'll figure something out."

Our main character Dill will be starting his second year this fall. He gets free tuition as long as he keeps his grades up, so making sure his internship restaurant succeeds is life or death for him.
That's why he's been prepping like crazy because prep work is everything in cooking, but...

"Huh, there's a special transfer student going to the Bayleaf branch? Wait, me? I'm the special transfer student?"

Just as he was about to really get things rolling for the grand opening, he got word he'd be shipped off to Bayleaf too. His teacher Rato broke the news about him transferring to the branch campus.
Maybe it's fate. Bayleaf is that far-off port town where Dill was born and raised. But after eight years away, his connections and sense of place are pretty much shot.
But it's not like he can say no. Now he has to go through with it, even if shooting for Master Chef is totally out of reach...

And so begins Dill's graduation challenge in an old town that changed.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220118173318/https://www.success-corp.co.jp/software/xbox/bistro2/main_story.html]the official website[/url]]
translation:
以我们的标准来看，这可能看起来很过时，但这是一个不同的时代，电力和电视确实存在。
在这个世界里，烹饪的意义远超现实。
故事发生在素有肉桂王国之称的美食大国。
首都皇家圣西蒙烹饪学院培养了一些世界顶级厨师，他们赢得了“大厨”的称号。这是一所享有盛誉的名校，以顽强着称。
他们的座右铭是：“一旦掌握了基础知识，接下来就是练习。”二年级学生，高年级学生，在校外的餐馆进行商业实习。当实习开始时，他们的毕业考试也开始了。

“我可能会在这里跳跃，但从第一年起我就一直在兼职工作，我现在认识人并且关注一些地方……所以我会想办法。”

我们的主角迪尔将于今年秋天开始他的第二年。只要他保持成绩，他就可以获得免费学费，因此确保他的实习餐厅成功对他来说是生死攸关的事情。
这就是为什么他疯狂地准备，因为准备工作就是烹饪的一切，但是……

“呃，有一个特殊转学生要去月叶分校？等等，我？我就是那个特殊转学生？”

正当他准备为盛大的开幕式做好准备时，他得到消息称自己也将被派往湾叶。他的老师拉托透露了他转学到分校的消息。
也许这就是命运。湾叶是迪尔出生和长大的那个遥远的港口小镇。但离开八年后，他的人脉和地方感几乎消失了。
但他又不能说不。现在他必须完成这一切，即使拍摄《大厨》完全遥不可及……

迪尔在一个发生了变化的老城区的毕业挑战就这样开始了。

[翻译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220118173318/https://www.success-corp.co.jp/software/xbox/bistro2/main_story.html]官方网站[/url]]
